sifnos.description: Sifnos is a beautiful Cycladic island known for its excellent cuisine, traditional architecture, and stunning beaches. It's less touristy than Mykonos or Santorini but equally beautiful.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Get in touch with Elena Philippou, your host at Villa Olivia Clara
contact.hostDescription: Get to know Elena Philippou, your host at Villa Olivia Clara
contact.hostTitle: Your Host at Villa Olivia Clara
contact.welcomeMessage: I am delighted to welcome you to the island that has been my family's home for generations- since the 1800s! Although I only used to spend my summers here, I have now moved in permanently. I originally built Villa Olivia Clara to be my family's summer home, so it brings me immense joy to share this special place with you.
contact.cultureMessage: The Cycladic culture, the picturesque natural beauty and the hospitable people of this island are what drew me in. Life flows slowly here on Sifnos- you can take a moment to relax and listen to the waves.
contact.signature: I can't wait to see you there. - Elena

testimonials.title: What Our Guests Are Saying
testimonials.subtitle: Average rating of 5 stars from more than 45 reviews in the past 10 years.

alexis.text: Wonderful stay at the Villa Olivia Clara! The house has a perfect location near Platis Gialos, walking distance, and an amazing view on the bay. No hesitation: the best villa in Sifnos.
alexis.author: — Alexis

liChuen.text: We have literally had the most magical holiday at Elena's villa. The photos just don't do justice to this incredibly stunning home. Please do not hesitate to book!
liChuen.author: — Li-Chuen

maria.text: The villa exceeded all our expectations. The pool area is fantastic, the location is perfect, and Elena was an amazing host. We can't wait to come back!
maria.author: — Maria

savvas.text: We were over the moon with our experience at Villa Olivia Clara. The photos don't even do it justice. Highly recommended.
savvas.author: — Savvas
